record_type_quote: This report focuses on the robustness of the original findings by assessing their computational reproducibility and conducting alternative cleaning procedures and statistical analyses to evaluate both practical and statistical significance.

targets.authors: Combs, A., Tierney, G., Guay, B., Merhout, F., Bail, C. A., Hillygus, D. S., & Volfovsky, A.
targets.title: Reducing political polarization in the United States with a mobile chat platform.
targets.evidence_quote: To achieve these aims, we use publicly available data from Harvard Dataverse (Combs et al., 2023b) and use cleaned (i.e. not raw) data including indicators used for global depolarization index provided to us by the authors for the purposes of reproduction.1
targets.outcome_computational_quote: While the data and corresponding R syntax were reproducible, robustness was only partially supported as modifications, such as omitting winsorizing, significantly altered result interpretations.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Additionally, the statistical assumptions for the final index score creation were not met, and re-analysis using an alternative index led to statistically insignificant results.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors judge the original computations reproduced with minor numerical/reporting deviations; one omitted between-party comparison could not be rerun. Alternative cleaning and valid-index construction materially qualify the findings.

reasoning: Original-data computational reproduction and alternative analyses of one published paper. Source title and authors verified; source names David rather than assigned Daniel Lacko.
